Karnataka launches Tathyakosh data discovery platform

Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah launched Tathyakosh.in, a public data discovery platform, on November 20, 2023. The platform aims to consolidate public datasets from various sources, making them accessible for researchers, developers, startups, and policymakers. Tathyakosh is expected to host approximately 1.5 million public datasets, facilitating easier discovery and assessment of this information.
